title: 100,000 Trees to Fall: Green Nod for Siyom Hydro Project Inflames Siang Basin Protests

ai.summary: The Forest Advisory Committee recommended forest clearance for a 1,000-MW hydro project in Arunachal Pradesh, threatening indigenous communities' ancestral lands and livelihoods.

facts.claim: The Forest Advisory Committee (FAC) of the Union Environment Ministry has recommended Stage-I (in-principle) forest clearance for the 1,000-MW Naying Hydroelectric Project in Arunachal Pradesh
facts.quote: Arunachal Pradesh: Amid escalating protests against mega-dams in the Siang river basin, another massive infrastructure development has cleared a major regulatory hurdle. The Forest Advisory Committee (FAC) of the Union Environment Ministry has recommended Stage-I (in-principle) forest clearance for the 1,000-MW Naying Hydroelectric Project in Arunachal Pradesh on Tuesday.

facts.claim: The project requires diversion of 470.8 hectares of 'unclassed forest' land and felling of 1,04,036 trees
facts.quote: the run-of-the-river scheme will require the diversion of roughly 470.8 hectares of "unclassed forest" land and the felling of an estimated 1,04,036 trees

facts.claim: The target area sits within a 'high conservation value zone' encompassing exceptionally dense forest patches
facts.quote: Crucially, the FAC itself noted that the target area sits within a "high conservation value zone" encompassing exceptionally dense forest patches.

facts.claim: The project threatens indigenous communities' ancestral lands and livelihoods
facts.quote: Indigenous Adi groups fear the collective hydel push will submerge ancestral lands, ruin local livelihoods, and permanently destroy the river systems central to their cultural heritage.

facts.claim: Local landowners were never informed or consulted about the proposed dam project
facts.quote: Communities and individual landowners were never informed or consulted about the proposed dam project
